   OLD TOWN LA VERNE BUSINESS IMPROVEMENT DISTIRICT
  MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING
  Monday, September 9, 2024

1.  WELCOME AND CALL TO ORDER

  Chairperson Walters called the meeting to order at 8:34 a.m. The following Board
  Members were present: Craig Walters, Marianne Stark, Micky Rehm, Zuhey Espinoza,
  and George Henderson. City Representatives present: Community Development Director
  Eric Scherer, City Manager Ken Domer, Mayor Tim Hepburn and Secretary Natalie
  Hiatt. Others present: Mia Valdez and Wayne Hurley.

2.  CALENDAR

  Latino College Expo  Saturday, September 14th 10am-
  2pm
  Beer Walk  (Cancelled)

  Halloween Trick or Treat  Thursday, October 31st 2-5pm
  Cruisin La Verne Car Show  Saturday, November 23rd 10am-
  4pm
  Holiday Stroll  Saturday, December 7th 3pm

3.  APPROVAL OF THE MINUTES

  It was moved by Mr. Henderson and seconded by Ms. Rehm to approve the minutes of
  the August 5, 2024 meeting. Motion carried by a 4-0 vote (Dr. Espinoza arrived after the
  approval of minutes).

4.  NEW BUSINESS

  A.  Evaluation and Action Plan Proposal – Mr. Scherer stated that six proposals were
  received. The proposal selected by the sub-committee and City staff is from
  Community Strong Strategies based out of Los Angeles with a proposed budget of
  $30,700.

  Mr. Domer stated that there are benefits of hiring a firm to help assist with the
  groups day to day activities and organizing events such as the beer and wine
  walks. He stated that this would be a good investment in the BID’s future.

  Mr. Scherer stated that the Leah Skinner is no longer with the Chamber. Mr.
  Scherer is hopeful that the BID, Association, and Chamber can partner with social
  media and marketing.

  The Board asked who is financially responsible.
   Mr. Scherer stated that the reserve account has a balance of roughly $180,000 that
  can be used.

  The Board discussed having the City pay for a portion of the fee.

  Chairperson Walters stated that it would be a benefit to have outside eyes evaluate
  and explore other funding mechanisms outside the current events.

  Mr. Domer stated that the City did not budget for the expense this fiscal year, but
  the Board could ask City Council.

  Mayor Hepburn feels the analysis is important and a partnership with the district
  and Chamber is beneficial.

  It was moved by Ms. Stark and seconded by Ms. Rehm to approve the proposal if
  the BID and the City split the cost. Motion carried by a 5-0 vote.

5.  CONTINUED BUSINESS

6.  COMMITTEE REPORTS/ UPDATES

  A. City Report (Eric Scherer): None
  B. University Report (Zuhey Espinoza): Dr. Espinoza announced that the Latino Expo
  will be hosted on September 14th and ULV will be hosting a voting center.
  C. Marketing (Micky Rehm): Ms. Rehm stated that the tree decorator will be $1,900,
  previously it costs $1,200. Ms. Rehm will coordinate the post card but asked for
  volunteers to coordinate the entertainment and tree delivery and set up. Dr. Espinoza
  will check to see if the ULV choir is available. Mr. Henderson will contact Sanders
  Towing and ask if they can pick up and deliver the tree to Mainiero Square.
  D. Chamber Report (Wayne Hurley): Mr. Hurley stated that Michael Mergil is working
  to hire a new director and support staff. Mr. Hurley will reach out to ULV for
  support.
  E. Social Media Update (Micky Rehm): Ms. Rehm received website proposals to discuss
  at the Association meeting.
  F. Financial Report: None

7.  PUBLIC COMMENT (Any discussion or action on non-agendized items must be
  deferred to the following meeting, as required by California Brown Act Law)

  Jason Cruz of 1236 Highland Drive was present at the meeting. Mr. Cruz is opposed to
  the patio expansion at Café Wang restaurant.

  Mr. Scherer explained that the Board already voted for the removal of the patio
  expansion. Staff is working to draft a new policy. In the meantime, City Council
   approved the patio through June 2025. The draft policy will be brought to City Council
  before the end of the calendar year.

8.  ADJOURNMENT

  Meeting was adjourned at 9:34 a.m., the next regular meeting to be held on October 7,
  2024 at 8:30 a.m. at Café Wang – 2316 D Street, La Verne CA 91750.

  Respectively submitted,

  _____________________
  Natalie Hiatt
